name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Sour Apple Diesel + Cherry Slushie Kush
description:
Sharp, tangy apple flavors collide with sweet cherry slushie notes for a bold flavor combo. Flip between the sour kick and candy-like sweetness, or combine them for a perfectly balanced punch.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
